question: Which of the following is recognized as a classical dance of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bharatnatyam** is one of the oldest and most renowned classical dance forms of India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is deeply rooted in **Natya Shastra**, the ancient treatise on performing arts written by Bharat Muni.
 
• Traditionally, Bharatnatyam was performed in temples as a form of devotional expression to narrate **mythological stories and spiritual ideas**.
 
• The dance form is characterized by intricate footwork, graceful gestures, and facial expressions known as **Abhinaya**, which convey emotions and tell stories.
 
• Bharatnatyam is recognized globally for its **rhythmic precision, aesthetic beauty, and spiritual significance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Classical Dance Forms of India**

 
 
• India has **eight recognized classical dance forms**, which include Bharatnatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, and Sattriya.
 
• Each dance form originates from a specific region and reflects the cultural heritage of that area.
 
 
 
• **Natya Shastra**
 
 
• Natya Shastra is an ancient Indian Sanskrit text attributed to Bharat Muni, detailing the foundation of **music, dance, and drama**.
 
• It serves as a guide for the technical and aesthetic aspects of performing arts.
 
 
 
• **Devotional Aspect of Bharatnatyam**
 
 
• Bharatnatyam was historically performed as a form of worship in temples, primarily to honor Lord Shiva in his **Nataraja form**.
 
• The dance symbolizes the union of the soul with the divine.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of Bharatnatyam**
 
 
• The dance form integrates three key elements: **Natya (dramatic art), Nritta (rhythmic dance), and Nritya (expressive dance).**
 
• The costumes are vibrant, adorned with intricate jewelry, and complement the storytelling aspect of the dance.
